groups.D: Exact feature behavior (SQS, CloudFront, tenancy, ASG, deploy routing)

1.keywords: multiple consumer apps + read lag on KDS
1.trap: Firehose is a delivery service to S3/Redshift/OpenSearch — consumer apps can't read from it
1.rule: Many KDS consumers lagging → Enhanced Fan-Out (dedicated 2 MB/s/shard per consumer)

4.trap: Snowmobile is for ≥10 PB at a single site
4.rule: <10 PB → many Snowball Edge Storage Optimized; Snow lands in S3 → lifecycle to Glacier (never direct to Glacier)

6.keywords: Firehose source already = Kinesis Data Streams; Agent writes to same Firehose
6.trap: Kinesis Agent CAN write to both KDS and Firehose
6.rule: KDS as Firehose source disables Firehose PutRecord/PutRecordBatch → producers must write to the KDS

8.keywords: simultaneous feed, each group independent, real-time
8.trap: SQS: one consumer deletes the message — no fan-out of the same record
8.rule: Many apps read the same stream concurrently/replay → Kinesis Data Streams

9.keywords: lag loading dynamic images + 504 timeouts; DynamoDB metrics fine
9.trap: X-Ray (E) right, but API Gateway access logs (D) only show who called what, not why Lambda is slow
9.rule: Slow Lambda behind API GW → Lambda CloudWatch Logs (processing time) + X-Ray traces

12.keywords: delay CERTAIN messages 1 min, others immediately
12.trap: Delay queue delays EVERY message in the queue
12.rule: Per-message delay → message timer (DelaySeconds on send); whole queue → delay queue

13.keywords: permanently record all traffic into WAF-protected ALB
13.trap: CloudTrail is not a WAF log destination
13.rule: WAF logs → CloudWatch Logs / S3 / Firehose; Firehose → S3 → Athena for analysis

15.keywords: 200 TB, shortest time, 500 Mbps DX / 1 Gbps VPN
15.trap: 1 Gbps ≈ 0.125 GB/s → 200 TB ≈ 18.5 days of perfect transfer
15.rule: Do the math: if link time > ~1 week, ship Snowball Edge (80 TB each → 3 devices)

20.keywords: mobile clients cache DNS, only 2 days, blue/green
20.trap: Route 53 weighted is DNS-based → stale client caches ignore the new weights
20.rule: DNS caching blocks a fast shift → Global Accelerator endpoint weights / traffic dials

21.keywords: content that SKIPS the regional edge cache
21.trap: Static files, product photos, user videos all go THROUGH the regional edge cache
21.rule: Skip regional edge cache: proxy methods PUT/POST/PATCH/OPTIONS/DELETE + dynamic content forwarding all headers

22.keywords: mixed Windows+Linux fleet, auditable, MINIMAL effort
22.trap: AWS-ApplyPatchBaseline is legacy Windows-only; OS-native patching = more effort
22.rule: Patch Manager: AWS-RunPatchBaseline + SSM Agent + maintenance window

24.keywords: LC tenancy vs VPC tenancy (dedicated/default mix)
24.trap: Assumed the VPC default overrides the LC (or vice versa)
24.rule: Either LC or VPC = dedicated → instances are dedicated

26.trap: Config (C) right; A makes CloudTrail+SNS do auto-revert — CloudTrail only records
26.rule: Continuous config compliance → AWS Config rules + CloudTrail trail → CloudWatch Logs (KMS)

27.keywords: unhealthy instance + AZ rebalancing after manual terminate
27.trap: E right; B wrong — ASG does not terminate+launch in one activity
27.rule: Unhealthy → terminate FIRST then launch; AZ rebalancing → launch FIRST then terminate

2.watch: batch size must reach 300 TPS × batch ≥ 2,400 — smallest batch that works
2.rule: FIFO 300 TPS (3,000 msg/s with batching of 10) → pick the minimal batch that covers peak

3.keywords: start/stop Beanstalk daily, one-stop scheduler, lowest ops
3.watch: Step Functions wait state = pay for long waits/complexity

5.keywords: hundreds of low-traffic PoC apps, lowest cost + least effort
5.watch: one EC2/Beanstalk per app = many idle instances
5.rule: Many small apps → containerize and bin-pack on ECS behind one ALB

7.keywords: Chef on-prem, minimal workflow change, less ops

10.watch: 429 before Lambda = API GW account throttle, not Lambda
10.rule: Per-client quotas → usage plans + API keys

11.keywords: web/app tiers replaced in 6 months, cut cost now
11.watch: RI for tiers being retired = wasted commitment; Spot not reliable
11.rule: Short-lived tiers → On-Demand; long-lived DB → RI

14.keywords: raw kept 5 yrs untouched, curated queried by Athena
14.watch: curated to Deep Archive breaks Athena
14.rule: Raw archive → Deep Archive; Athena data → compressed columnar

16.rule: API GW REST stateless; WebSocket stateful full-duplex

17.watch: Q8: SQS is wrong when many apps need the SAME record
17.rule: Order buffer with spikes → SQS + Lambda

18.keywords: faster Lambda deploy, auto detect + rollback
18.watch: change sets have no pre/post traffic hooks
18.rule: Lambda canary/linear + auto rollback → SAM + CodeDeploy + CloudWatch alarms

19.keywords: 99.99% SLA global, auto failover, lowest cost
19.rule: Global + spiky + cheapest → S3 + API GW + Lambda + DynamoDB global tables, latency routing

23.keywords: ElastiCache Redis secure from unauthorized access
23.watch: SG outbound rule / CloudTrail are not access controls
23.rule: Redis security → SG inbound 6379 + in-transit/at-rest encryption + AUTH token

25.keywords: one install file vs whole members' area
25.rule: Single file → signed URL; many files → signed cookies

inconsistent: SQS fits a work buffer, not a multi-consumer fan-out stream
Know exact service behavior (stateful/stateless; DNS caching vs anycast)
Service knobs: usage plans right, SQS message timer vs delay queue missed
